claims.text: Cetirizine (OTC, adults and children 6 and over): one 10 mg dose QD, ⍉more than 10 mg in 24 hrs.
claims.quote: adults and children 6 years and over | one 10 mg capsule once daily; do not take more than one 10 mg capsule in 24 hours.

claims.text: Ask a doctor first w liver or kidney dz.
claims.quote: Ask a doctor before use if you have liver or kidney disease.

claims.text: Cetirizine: EToH, sedatives and tranquilizers may increase drowsiness, so ⍉alcoholic drinks.
claims.quote: avoid alcoholic drinks alcohol, sedatives, and tranquilizers may increase drowsiness

claims.text: Fexofenadine (OTC, adults and children 12 and over): one 180 mg tablet w H2O Q1x day.
claims.quote: adults and children 12 years of age and over | take one 180 mg tablet with water once a day

claims.text: Ask a doctor first w kidney dz.
claims.quote: Ask a doctor before use if you have kidney disease.

claims.text: Fexofenadine: ⍉@ the same time as aluminum or magnesium antacids, and ⍉w fruit juices.
claims.quote: do not take at the same time as aluminum or magnesium antacids do not take with fruit juices
